test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The ______ needs of the inhabitants seem to be fruit, iced drinks, shiny boots, and lottery tickets.
solution:
The correct answer is "**principal**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Principal means ​'most important; main (**सबसे महत्वपूर्ण; मुख्‍य**)**'.**

 
 
• ​Example: *The judge examined the **principal **witness.*
 
 
 
• All the other options are contextually incorrect.

 

​​​​​​Hence, option 4 is the correct answer. 

Complete Sentence__:* **The __principal__ needs of the inhabitants seem to be fruit, iced drinks, shiny boots, and lottery tickets.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Amiable **means friendly and pleasant (**मैत्रीपूर्ण और सौहार्दपूर्ण; मिलनसार**).
 
• **Principle **means a basic general law, rule or idea (**सामान्‍य सिद्धांत, नियम या विचार**).
 
• **Invincible **means too strong or powerful to be defeated (**इतना सशक्त या बलशाली कि पराजित न किया जा सके; अपराजेय, अजेय**).
